title.narrative: Callable Funds for the Standby Recovery Financing Facility of the Global Facility for Disaster Reduction and Recovery (GFDRR)

description.narrative: THE OBJECTIVE OF TRACK III (AS STIPULATED IN THE GFDRR CHARTER) IS provide a speedycomma predictable and effective mechanism for enhancing international institutional preparedness for disaster recoverycomma supporting joint needs assessmentscomma and recovery and development planning by national governmentscomma doctorscomma UNcomma World Bank and other IFIs in all disaster situations and providing supplemental financing for accelerated recoverycomma primarily in low income countries that have been affected by disaster(s)comma before formulating and launching medium and long term recovery programs and following the humanitarian phase. This track is deployed to strengthen mobilization of international assistance for prevention investmentscomma have limited fiscal space and may require addtional resoirces for accelerated recovery without having to significantly reallocate earmarked development resources to recover from disasters when they do occur. By linking post-disaster assistance for recovery from this Fund with ex ante measures taken by the recipeint organization before a disastercomma and introducing risk reduction during the recovery operationscomma this Fund creates incentives for governments and agencies to be proactive and integrate disaster risk considertaions ex ante in development which is the mission of GFDRR.
